server.roster_how: Run 'python3 scripts/fleet/lanparty.py roster ssam-tfe' (ran 2026-11-11: __info__ 0/16), or send '\status\' to UDP 192.168.1.132:25601. The reply carries player_N, frags_N and ping_N, plus numplayers, maxplayers and gamemode: paused when empty, openplaying with players (scripts/game-servers/serioussam/README.md). The names are each box's own profile, decoded from Players\Player0.plr on 2026-11-11: 'Serious Sam' on .110 .124 .133 .143 .171 .240, 'toaster' on .123, 'ArchoN' on .184. Use the names as a COUNT only, never to identify a box.
server.log_how: Note the line count first: 95 lines at 14:30, nobody joined since the 11:02 start. The log resets at every server start. Then read only the new lines: tr -d '\r' < ~/ssam-tfe-server/Dedicated_NSCFleet.log | grep -a -n -E "Connection initiated from|CRC check OK|ordered to disconnect|Forcing client|disconnected\.| joined$". This is the engine's own log: root-owned, world-readable, CRLF, current. The '^o<name>^r joined' line carries NO IP. Rule: a box is IN when its LAST "Server: Client '192.168.1.<octet>', CRC check OK" line is followed by a joined line BEFORE any other client's CRC line, and no later "Server: Client '192.168.1.<octet>' disconnected." appears. 'Sent connection data' and 'Sent CRC challenge' lines for other IPs may sit in between, as .171's did on 2026-10-13. Several CRC lines for one IP with no joined line after them mean that box is NOT in and is about to time out: .124 and .133 logged four each on 2026-10-13, then 'Client ... ordered to disconnect: Connection timeout' (twice), 'Forcing client ... to disconnect' and 'Server: Client ... disconnected.'. Cross-check numplayers in \status\ against the count of IN boxes. journalctl --user -u ssam-tfe-server shows only start and stop, because stdout is appended to ~/ssam-tfe-server/server.log. 'docker logs sstfesrv' lags: on 2026-11-11 it stopped at 'network is on', and the engine log has the 'started.' and 'ALL OK' lines it lacks.
server.bots_note: Serious Engine 1 has no bots and this server runs none, so every player_N is a real box and numplayers counts humans only. 16 slots cover the 8 boxes.
server.changes_needed: None for the round. Slots were raised from 8 to 16 on 2026-10-13, and ser_bWaitFirstPlayer=0 is set. Library follow-ups, NOT made: (1) The Join launcher spec could write sam_bFirstStarted=0; and sam_strNetworkSettings="Scripts\\NetSettings\\LAN.ini"; into Game_startup.ini. That file runs during InitializeGame (SeriousSam.exe call at 0x42184f), after PersistentSymbols.ini and before the first-run check at 0x421854. No box would then need the pre-seed. It forces LAN on every start, and GAMERES also writes Game_startup.ini, so keep the two writers consistent. (2) The open item in scripts/game-servers/serioussam/README.md is answered: the choice persists as sam_strNetworkSettings in Scripts\PersistentSymbols.ini (.110 .123 .184 .240 hold the LAN path today). Staging it would only PRE-SELECT LAN. The CONNECTION SETTINGS page still shows on every +connect, because the call at 0x40a295 has no condition. (3) requires.json and plan_args notes say the engine has a Direct3D renderer. TFE 1.00's Engine.dll imports only OPENGL32.DLL and 3DFXVGL.DLL, which matches NOTES.txt.

launchers.bat:
@echo off
rem Serious Sam TFE fleet round - join the dedicated server on {host} port 25600.
rem SeriousSam.exe v1.00 takes no player name on its command line, so each box
rem keeps the name in its own Players\Player0.plr - the server log names boxes by IP.
taskkill /f /im ssstars.scr >nul 2>&1
set "SSD=C:\Games\SeriousSamFirstEncounter"
set "SSP=C:\Games\SeriousSamFirstEncounter\Scripts\PersistentSymbols.ini"
rem The engine saves these two first-run answers only on a CLEAN exit, and a
rem round ended by PROCKILL never exits cleanly. Missing, the box shows the
rem starting-for-the-first-time box and has no LAN connection setting to
rem pre-select. Appended only when missing - the engine itself rewrites the
rem file with the same values the next time it exits cleanly.
findstr /i /l /c:"sam_bFirstStarted=(INDEX)0" "%SSP%" >nul 2>&1 || findstr /i /l /c:"sam_bFirstStarted=0" "%SSP%" >nul 2>&1 || >>"%SSP%" echo sam_bFirstStarted=0;
findstr /i /l /c:"LAN.ini" "%SSP%" >nul 2>&1 || >>"%SSP%" echo sam_strNetworkSettings="Scripts\\NetSettings\\LAN.ini";
call "%SSD%\Join Serious Sam TFE - LAN.bat" {host}:25600
launchers.notes: Run it with LAUNCH, not EXEC. lanparty.py uploads it as C:\fleetmp\<key>.bat and LAUNCHes that path. The C:\fleetmp\ssam-tfe.bat already on the boxes is the 2026-10-13 two-liner, without the screensaver kill or the pre-seed. The bat is valid cmd and pure ASCII. {name} is unused on purpose: SeriousSam.exe 1.00 accepts only +level +game +cdpath +password +connect +script +goto (string table), and no shell symbol holds a player name. The staged Join launcher has the same size and timestamp on all 8 boxes as the library copy (26,775 B, 2026-10-03 14:04). It cds to its own folder, calls FLEETRES.BAT, writes Game_startup.ini with sam_bFullScreen=1, and ends with a bare 'exit', so nothing may follow the 'call'. HOSTIP comes from argv first, so the stale C:\Games\lanhost.txt on six boxes is ignored; no box has a per-title lanhost.txt. The findstr checks match the engine's own 'extern INDEX sam_bFirstStarted=(INDEX)0;' and .133's hand-written 'sam_bFirstStarted=0;'. Every current PersistentSymbols.ini ends in CRLF and none is read-only. An appended bare assignment runs after the engine's own extern line, so it wins (.124 holds sam_strNetworkSettings=""). AFTER LAUNCH: (1) Wait until PROCLIST shows SeriousSam.exe and WINLIST lists a window 'Serious Sam (FullScreen WxH)', then 3 s more. That takes 15-40 s, longer if the image had to be mounted. (2) If WINLIST foreground is 'Information', send UIKEY RETURN. (3) CONNECTION SETTINGS: the first time this pre-seed runs, take a frame and confirm 'LAN gaming' (row 5 of 6) is highlighted, then send UIKEY RETURN. If another row is highlighted, move to LAN first; from row 1 that is DOWN x4. (4) About 2 s later, send UIKEY RETURN on SELECT PLAYERS, where START is focused. Stagger (4) about 5 s between boxes, slow boxes last: .110 .123 .240 .171 .143 .184 .124 .133. (5) Within about 60 s each box must be IN by the server-log rule. If a box shows several CRC lines with no joined line, or a Connection timeout, its client is back on SELECT PLAYERS with START focused. Confirm with a frame and send ONE UIKEY RETURN; that in-process retry is how .133 (2026-10-13) and .110 (2026-10-15) got in. PROCKILL SeriousSam.exe and re-LAUNCH this launcher only if the retry fails. Without the two findstr lines the keys differ per box: RETURN, RETURN on .110/.123/.184/.240 (LAN saved); DOWN x4, RETURN, RETURN on .124/.133; RETURN (Information), DOWN x4, RETURN, RETURN on .143/.171. For a single-player render check, use instead: call "C:\Games\SeriousSamFirstEncounter\Play Serious Sam - The First Encounter.bat". It is the same launcher with GAMEARGS empty, and opens the menu over the attract demo. Optional per-box names are deliberately NOT in this launcher. They need a binary Players\Player0.plr swap, in a format verified on all 8 boxes: 'PLC4', int32 name length, name, int32 team length (0), 16-byte GUID, 32 bytes of appearance. Back up the original first: .123 'toaster' and .184 'ArchoN' are real players' names.

SeriousSamFirstEncounter.in_game_proof: The primary per-box proof is the server's engine log, ~/ssam-tfe-server/Dedicated_NSCFleet.log. Note its line count before the round and read only the new lines with: tr -d '\r' < ~/ssam-tfe-server/Dedicated_NSCFleet.log | grep -a -n -E "Connection initiated from|CRC check OK|ordered to disconnect|Forcing client|disconnected\.| joined$". The '^o<name>^r joined' line has NO IP. So a box is IN only when its LAST "Server: Client '192.168.1.<octet>', CRC check OK" is followed by a joined line before any other client's CRC line, and no later "Server: Client '192.168.1.<octet>' disconnected." appears. Several CRC lines for one IP with no joined line after them are NOT a pass. On 2026-10-13 that pattern belonged only to .124 and .133, four CRC lines each, and both were dropped with 'Connection timeout' about a minute later. A looser reading of the log, 'a joined line appears somewhere after its CRC line', counted .124 as in before it was dropped. Required corroboration: GameSpy \status\ on UDP 192.168.1.132:25601 shows numplayers equal to the number of IN boxes (SE1 has no bots), and gamemode changes from paused to openplaying. Optional: 'lanparty.py sniff ssam-tfe' counts each box's packets to :25600 with tcpdump (~/.fleet-sudo is present; iface enp129s0). Per-box tie-breaker: DOWNLOAD C:\Games\SeriousSamFirstEncounter\SeriousSam.log. The agent opens files with share-write, so it can usually be read while the game runs. After the LAST "Joining session at: '<host>'" look for '  joined', "Adding player: '^o<name>^r'" and '  done.'; 'Cannot add player because: Connection timeout' means the box is not in. Frames: each box should show the HUD (health 100 bottom-left) and a top-right frag list with one line per player. Roster names do NOT identify boxes: six are 'Serious Sam', .123 is 'toaster', .184 is 'ArchoN'. A running SeriousSam.exe is not proof, because a box stuck on CONNECTION SETTINGS or SELECT PLAYERS looks identical in PROCLIST.
SeriousSamFirstEncounter.screenshot_notes: XP GDI 'SCREENSHOT 1' captures Serious Engine's fullscreen OpenGL frame, menus and gameplay, on .110 .123 .133 .143 .171 .184 and .240. These were real frames on 2026-10-13, including .133 caught on SELECT PLAYERS. A frame can therefore confirm which menu, and which highlighted row, a box is on before keys are sent. .124 renders through our MesaFX ICD 0.1.84 over Glide on vcr-kmd. Its 2026-10-13 GDI frame came back as garbled 'PLAYERS' tiles. Use 'EXECW 30 C:\vcr\vcrctl.exe fbshot C:\fleetmp\fb.bmp' and then DOWNLOAD the file. vcrctl.exe (326,480 B) is in C:\vcr, and fbshot works under Glide/OpenGL; it hangs only under D3D exclusive mode, which TFE never uses. The current lanparty.py takes .124's frame this way. The 'Information' and 'CD check' dialogs appear before the mode switch and capture normally. TFE runs in 32-bit colour, so the 8-bit DirectDraw wrong-colour issue does not apply. No Win7 box is in this round, so the black-frame rule does not apply either. WINLIST foreground was an empty string on 7 of 10 boxes while the game ran on 2026-10-13; take a frame when it is.
known_blockers: No per-box player name. SeriousSam.exe v1.00 accepts only +level, +game, +cdpath, +password, +connect, +script and +goto (confirmed in the string table), and no shell symbol holds the name. The name lives only in the binary Players\Player0.plr, so the server roster cannot tell boxes apart. Identify each box by its IP in the server log.

The launcher alone cannot finish the join, because this build has no +quickjoin. +connect calls StartMenus("join") (0x421c46 -> 0x408eb0 -> 0x40a260), which always shows CONNECTION SETTINGS (unconditional call to 0x40b080 at 0x40a295) and then SELECT PLAYERS. The orchestrator must send two UIKEY RETURNs per box once the window is up. Both menus are keyboard-navigable, and all 10 boxes were driven this way on 2026-10-13.

On 2026-10-13 all ten 'Connection initiated' lines arrived in one burst. .124 and .133, both 255 MB boxes, logged four 'CRC check OK' lines each, never 'joined', and were dropped with 'Connection timeout'. Stagger the START RETURNs about 5 s apart, slow boxes last, and treat a box as not in until its joined line appears. Retry a timed-out box with one RETURN on START, and relaunch only if that fails.

The pre-seed + RETURN, RETURN path is unproven on hardware. UIKEY goes to the FOCUSED window. Before every key, check that WINLIST foreground is 'Serious Sam (FullScreen WxH)' or 'Information'; if the foreground title is empty, take a frame. A RETURN that lands on the desktop opens the selected icon. Killing ssstars.scr does not reset the idle timer, so the screensaver may return before the game takes focus. If it does, PROCKILL it again; never send RETURN to it.

The launcher writes to the box. When the two first-run lines are missing it appends them to the box's own Scripts\PersistentSymbols.ini. That file is per-box state: it is not staged, GAMESYNC does not touch it, and the engine saves the same values on a clean exit. The game may then start against another disc and raise 'CD check'. On .124 the Join launcher first falls back to WinCDEmu. TFE has NO Direct3D renderer (Engine.dll loads only OPENGL32.DLL and 3DFXVGL.DLL; sam_iDriver 0 = OpenGL, 1 = 3dfx MiniGL), so the vcr-kmd D3D HAL risk does not apply. The game must keep ogl_bExclusive=1, which the Join launcher writes into Game_startup.ini from FR_UE1DEV (present on .124 today). Without it TFE exits about 20 s in (commit b8215af).

C:\Games\lanhost.txt is stale on six boxes (.123 and .171 -> .124; .133 and .240 -> .123; .143 and .184 -> .246). It is ignored only because the host is passed as the first argument, so never call the Join launcher without that argument.
The server's engine log resets at every server start or restart, and docker logs and server.log lag behind it. Record the line count before the round and read only the new lines.

The server uses gam_iFragLimit 20 with ded_tmTimeout 20. If spawn telefrags push one player to 20, the level restarts after 20 s. Clients stay connected and reload, but a frame may catch a load screen.

PROCKILL never saves PersistentSymbols.ini or the player profiles; the launcher's pre-seed covers the two first-run answers. The 'didn't shut down properly' notice is log-only (CPrintF at 0x421ec2), not a dialog. Windows restores the desktop mode when the process dies (CDS fullscreen), but still confirm each box is back at its proper desktop mode after the round.

review_issues: Timeout recovery is wrong, and the evidence for it is misquoted. The recipe says to PROCKILL and re-LAUNCH, and that 'one relaunch joined and held each time' for .124 and .133 on 2026-10-13 and .110 on 2026-10-15. The client logs show .133 (SeriousSam.log 2026-10-13 13:15) and .110 (2026-10-15 23:41) rejoined IN THE SAME PROCESS: 'Cannot add player because: Connection timeout / stopping game.', then a second 'Joining session ... joined ... Adding player ... done.', with no new startup header. The disassembly shows why: JoinNetworkGame (0x409d80) calls StopMenus (0x409100) only when JoinGame succeeds. On failure SELECT PLAYERS stays up with START focused, and .133's 2026-10-13 frame (grid_ssam-tfe.jpg) shows exactly that screen. Only .124's relaunch is documented (docs/lan-multiplayer-status.md), and its log has since been overwritten. Fixed: retry with one UIKEY RETURN on START first; relaunch only if that fails.

in_game_proof says 'The CRC line may repeat; that is fine.' That is wrong. In the 2026-10-13 server log the CRC line repeated (four times each) only for .124 and .133, right before their 'ordered to disconnect: Connection timeout / Forcing client / disconnected.' lines. Every box that held logged one CRC line and then 'joined'. The risk item 'relaunch any box whose IP has no CRC check OK about 60 s after its RETURN' misses exactly this failure, because those boxes did have CRC lines.

The join rule (CRC OK 'followed by' a joined line) is ambiguous. The '^o<name>^r joined' line carries no IP, and other clients' lines interleave: .171's joined line came after 'Sent connection data to .124', and .124's four CRC lines were followed by .110's CRC line and joined line. I tested this against the 2026-10-13 log. Read naively, it counts .124 as in at line 169, before it was dropped. Replaced with a stricter rule: the last CRC line for that IP, then a joined line before any other client's CRC line, then no disconnect. Added numplayers and the client log as cross-checks.

The log grep leaves out 'Forcing client ... to disconnect', although log_how lists it as a failure line. Added 'Forcing client' to the pattern. Checked on the 2026-10-13 log: 48 matching lines, 2 of them 'Forcing'. Against the live log the grep returns nothing (exit 1), because nobody has joined since the server started at 11:02. The log is 95 lines.

'This exact path got 10 of 10 boxes into one game on 2026-10-13' overstates it. The 10 included .145 and .197, which are not in this round and are both off. The 2026-10-13 run used C:\fleetmp\ssam-tfe.bat, which is only a call to the Join launcher, with no screensaver kill and no pre-seed. It drove each box with its own keys: RETURN on Information, DOWN x4 + RETURN, then RETURN on START. The new pre-seed + RETURN-RETURN path has never run on hardware. LAN pre-selection is inferred from the code: 0x40b120-0x40b13d copies sam_strNetworkSettings (declared at 0x43f954) into the menu's selected file, and sort type 3 is set at 0x40b0d7. It is backed only by .133's bare 'sam_bFirstStarted=0;' line, which demonstrably suppressed the Information box. Added a frame check on first use.

.124 also has WinCDEmu (C:\Program Files\WinCDEmu\batchmnt.exe). The Join launcher tries it when DAEMON Tools produces no drive. On .124, a locked DT unit therefore does not necessarily mean CD check and reboot, but the recipe describes the mount as DT-only.

.186 exclusion reason is incomplete. Its card is an NVIDIA 10DE:1F82 (TU117, GeForce GTX 1650 per pci.ids) on Microsoft's Standard VGA driver, and the OS is Windows 7 Professional 32-bit (audit-186 exec_os.txt). NVIDIA's 32-bit driver line ended with R390, before this card shipped, so this box probably cannot get accelerated OpenGL without a 64-bit OS or another card. Worth knowing for the driver half of the readiness check. The exclusion itself stands.

Minor: the recovery step names C:\fleetmp\SeriousSamFirstEncounter.bat. The file on the boxes today is C:\fleetmp\ssam-tfe.bat, from 2026-10-13, and it has none of the new lines. The new name exists only once the orchestrator uploads this launcher under this key (lanparty.py writes C:\fleetmp\<key>.bat). The re-launch step now says to use the file the orchestrator uploaded.

Minor: killing ssstars.scr is not user input, so the idle timer is not reset. The screensaver may come back before the game window has focus. This is possible, not observed. The existing 'check WINLIST before every key' rule covers it, and that is now stated explicitly.

Library note, not a recipe error: requires.json and the plan_args notes say the engine has 'an OpenGL and a Direct3D renderer'. TFE 1.00's Engine.dll imports only OPENGL32.DLL and 3DFXVGL.DLL. The recipe and NOTES.txt are right. Recorded as a follow-up; the library was not edited.

The launcher reuses the staged 'Join Serious Sam TSE - LAN.bat', which handles FLEETRES, the fullscreen Game_startup.ini and the disc mount. It passes '{host}:25610 +quickjoin' as the bat's single quoted host argument, so the exe gets '+connect 192.168.1.132:25610 +quickjoin'. +quickjoin is verified in the staged 1.05 SeriousSam.exe, and the disassembly was re-run independently. The parser sets [0x4370c4]. After logging 'Command line connection', that flag selects JoinNetworkGame (0x409ab0) instead of StartMenus('join'). This matches Croteam's released source, which documents the flag as 'do not ask for players and network settings'. JoinNetworkGame joins with the menu's local-player config. That config is one player on profile 0 on every box: the six SeriousSam.gms files say so, and .133/.143 have no .gms and fall back to the identical engine default. The exe uses '+connect X +quickjoin' itself for its mod restart, but the fleet has never used it. SE1 has no command-line option and no shell symbol for one; this was checked in the symbol tables of SeriousSam.exe, GameMP.dll and Engine.dll. Each box joins under its Players\Player0.plr profile: JabyBesus (.110), Toaster (.123), Xypher Orion (.124), Carter (.171), ArchoN (.184), and 'Player 0' (.133, .143, .240). The per-box proof is the per-IP 'CRC check OK' line in the engine's own log, /home/voidsstr/ssam-tse-server/Dedicated_NSCFleet.log. Do not use server.log or docker logs for this: they carry block-buffered stdout that lags or loses lines. 8 boxes against 16 slots means no server change is needed.

launchers.bat:
@echo off
rem Serious Sam TSE fleet round - join the dev host server with no menus.
rem The staged Join launcher calls FLEETRES.BAT, writes the fullscreen
rem Game_startup.ini, mounts the disc image and starts Bin\SeriousSam.exe;
rem +quickjoin rides in its quoted host argument so the exe joins at once.
set "T=C:\Games\SeriousSamSecondEncounter"
taskkill /f /im SeriousSam.exe >nul 2>&1
ping -n 3 127.0.0.1 >nul
cd /d "%T%"
rem A box only ever PROCKILLed keeps the retail PersistentSymbols.ini stub
rem and shows the first-run Information modal at every start.
find /i "sam_bFirstStarted" "%T%\Scripts\PersistentSymbols.ini" >nul 2>&1 || >>"%T%\Scripts\PersistentSymbols.ini" echo sam_bFirstStarted=0;
call "%T%\Join Serious Sam TSE - LAN.bat" "{host}:25610 +quickjoin"
launchers.notes: The same text goes on all 8 XP boxes, and every one has its games in C:\Games. 'Join Serious Sam TSE - LAN.bat' exists in the library and on every box (26,838 B, 2026-10-03). Scripts\PersistentSymbols.ini is per-box state and NOT in the library. It exists on all 8 boxes: a 34-byte stub ending in CRLF on .133/.143, and a full engine-written file elsewhere. The guard line creates it if missing. What the staged Join bat does: line 54 calls FLEETRES.BAT. Line 67 takes HOSTIP from %~1, which becomes '{host}:25610 +quickjoin'. Lines 80-88 write sam_bFullScreen=1, FR_W/FR_H, gfx_/gap_iRefreshRate=FR_SE1HZ, and ogl_bExclusive=1 where FR_UE1DEV is Glide (only .124). Line 80 overwrites Game_startup.ini with '>', so the wrapper cannot inject into that file. The bat mounts _disc\SeriousSamTSE.iso with 'start /b daemon.exe -mount 0,...' and skips the mount if a volume labelled SamSE is already present. Line 285 runs start "" /D <tree> Bin\SeriousSam.exe +connect %HOSTIP%. The bat ends with `exit`, so nothing after the call line runs. The guard line appends 'sam_bFirstStarted=0;' only where the file lacks the symbol (.133 and .143 today), and it is idempotent. Why it works, checked in the 1.05 exe: sam_bFirstStarted is [0x436010] with initial value 1 in .data, which is why a file without the symbol shows the modal. InitializeGame (0x4237a0) runs at 0x424302, and inside it GameMP's CGame::Initialize includes Scripts\PersistentSymbols.ini and then Scripts\Game_startup.ini. All of that happens before the sam_bFirstStarted test at 0x42432f. Drop the guard if per-box game state must not be touched, and use the first_run OK step instead. {name} is unused because the engine cannot take a name. Do NOT overwrite Players\Player0.plr: five boxes carry real players' names. Expected modes, from each box's current launcher-written Game_startup.ini (FLEETRES re-decides them at every launch): .110 1600x1200@85, .123 1280x960@100, .124 1280x960@85, .133 1280x960@85, .143 1280x960@60, .171 1280x960@85, .184 1024x768@85, .240 1920x1080@60. The renderer is the engine's choice. .171 persists sam_iGfxAPI=1 (Direct3D) on its FX 5500. Every other box has 0 (OpenGL), or no value, which defaults to OpenGL. .124 renders OpenGL through MesaFX 0.1.84 (its log reads 'Mesa Glide v0.62 Voodoo5 6000 [voodoo-cleanroom 0.1.84]'), Glide and vcr-kmd, not the D3D HAL. Fallback if +quickjoin ever misbehaves: lanparty.py's built-in ssam-tse launcher, the same call with an unquoted '{host}:25610' and no +quickjoin, proven 10/10 on 2026-10-13, plus the first_run menu keys.

SeriousSamSecondEncounter.in_game_proof:
Per box, in order of strength:
(1) The ENGINE's server log, /home/voidsstr/ssam-tse-server/Dedicated_NSCFleet.log. It is flushed after every line, world-readable, CRLF, and recreated at each server start. Before launch: F=/home/voidsstr/ssam-tse-server/Dedicated_NSCFleet.log; OFF=$(stat -c %s "$F"). After: [ "$(stat -c %s "$F")" -lt "$OFF" ] && OFF=0; tail -c +$((OFF+1)) "$F" | tr -d '\r' | grep -a -E 'Connection initiated from|CRC check OK|joined|disconnected| left|Cannot'. Per box it must hold "Server: Client '192.168.1.<octet>', CRC check OK", followed by a "^o<name>^r joined" line, and NO later "Server: Client '192.168.1.<octet>' disconnected." The joined line carries no IP and concurrent joins interleave, so map names to boxes from the profile list below, not from line order. review_issues: MATERIAL - wrong server-log witness. server.log (and docker logs) carry DedicatedServer.exe's stdout, which is block-buffered under Wine. Croteam's Console.cpp calls printf with no fflush for a dedicated server, but fflush(con_fLog) after every line for the engine's own log. Measured: the 11:03 startup lines 'started.' and 'ALL OK: Dedicated server is now running!' are in Dedicated_NSCFleet.log but still missing from server.log and from docker logs at 14:47. 'ALL OK' reached server.log in only 7 of 155 server starts. A box that joined can therefore be absent from server.log for minutes, or for good if the server restarts. The 2026-10-13 evidence file ssam-tse-server.log is the engine log (it has the '--- Serious Engine Startup ---' header and no ALSA/[entry] lines). Fixed: the primary witness is now /home/voidsstr/ssam-tse-server/Dedicated_NSCFleet.log, read from an offset with a guard for a server restart. server.log and docker logs are demoted to lagging backups.

MATERIAL - the quickjoin failure path is missing. If the join fails (timeout, CRC failure, server full), JoinNetworkGame leaves _gmRunningGameMode=GM_NONE and the main loop's bMenuForced calls StartMenus(). The game lands on the MAIN MENU, not on SELECT PLAYERS. SeriousSam.log then shows 'Joining session at' followed by 'Cannot join game: <reason>'. .184's own log already has one 'Cannot join game: Timeout while waiting for data'. The recipe's only fallback was SELECT PLAYERS ('quickjoin did not take'). Added a first_run entry: re-run the wrapper and do not drive the menu.

in_game_proof (4) is not reliable. In the 2026-10-13 TSE round the WINLIST foreground title was '' on all ten boxes while they were in game (evidence-lanparty-2026-10-13/ssam-tse.json; TFE had 7 of 10 empty), even though the exe carries 'Serious Sam (FullScreen %dx%d)'. An empty or different title must not count against a box.
